preconditions.description: N is an integer and S is a string.
The length of string S equals N.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (return_value in S and len(return_value) > 0)
postconditions.description: The return value is either '-1' or a non-empty substring of S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (lambda: (indices := [i for i in range(N - len(return_value) + 1) if S[i:i+len(return_value)] == return_value], any(indices[i] + len(return_value) <= indices[j] for i in range(len(indices)) for j in range(i+1, len(indices)))))[1]
postconditions.description: If not '-1', the returned substring appears at least twice in S with non-overlapping occurrences.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all((lambda: (indices := [i for i in range(N - len(candidate) + 1) if S[i:i+len(candidate)] == candidate], any(indices[i] + len(candidate) <= indices[j] for i in range(len(indices)) for j in range(i+1, len(indices)))))[1] == False for candidate in S if len(candidate) > len(return_value))
postconditions.description: If not '-1', no substring longer than the returned one exists that repeats non-overlappingly.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (first_occurrence := S.find(return_value)) == min([i for i in range(N - len(return_value) + 1) if S[i:i+len(return_value)] == return_value and any(S[j:j+len(return_value)] == return_value and i + len(return_value) <= j for j in range(i + len(return_value), N - len(return_value) + 1))])
postconditions.description: If multiple longest non-overlapping substrings exist, the one with the earliest first occurrence is returned.
